summary: [SPIKE] Review and cleanup type styles, partials and breakpoints
description:
h2. Design
There are inconsistencies with breakpoints and duplicative SCSS partials that cover a single front-end concern. Let's clean that up.

h2. Stakeholders
- Eng

h2. Tasks
- Review existing stylesheets
- catalog all breakpoints
- document the front-end components and modules at a logical level
- Ensure each partial has only a single concern and vice versa
- Ensure all breakpoints are consistent

h2. Acceptance Criteria
- Everything on the site still looks right, but breakpoints and components are sane across the frontend.
